articles.summary: CAYCE, S.C. (Sept. 9, 2026) In consultation with the South Carolina Department of Natural Resources and the South Carolina Department of Environmental Services, Dominion Energy will begin a drawdown of Lake Murray this fall. Dam operators will begin lowering the lake this month, with the lake level reaching approximately 350 feet in December. The lake is expected to remain at that target elevation until the end of January 2027. The drawdown will help control aquatic vegetation and maintain water
articles.title: Dominion Energy Will Lower Lake Murray Water Level This Fall to Curb Underwater Vegetation

articles.summary: Dominion Energy employee and military spouse, Mary Sale, gives remarks on her husband’s current deployment and support from the company. Dominion Energy South Carolina President, Keller Kissam (right), embraces employee and active service member Maurice Hodges (left).
